capabilities: Synchronize the vault with a Nas Server over the home intranet
Test the connection from the plugin settings
Run a manual update command to pull or push vault differences by timestamp
Register the NAS with a central server to obtain a NAT.ID
extras: Requires registering the NAS with a central server to get a NAT.ID and setting a connection password on the NAS Server; some settings labels appear untranslated in Chinese (唯一标识, 连接密码), and the Nas Server deployment itself is documented elsewhere (Docs link).
intentEvidence: If you simply want to synchronize multiple Vaults between multiple Obsidians, use the official synchronization service.
problem: Users who keep their vault on a home NAS have no built-in way to synchronize the vault between the NAS and Obsidian clients.

relations.evidence: If you simply want to synchronize multiple Vaults between multiple Obsidians, use the official synchronization service.

requires.name: a NAS with Nas Server installed

summary: Vault synchronization service that keeps an Obsidian vault in sync with a Nas Server on a home intranet NAS via P2P.
